doc: Map script for d06b01, the Moon Flower Palace boss floor where Emperor Griffon is fought in several phases. It plays the confrontation and phase-change scenes (events 716, 720, 724), a dark power scene (728) and a Griffon challenge scene (640), places the boss for each phase, and sends the player to maps s64, s31, s44, s32 or dungeon d06b03 between fights.
